lines.en: I walk on over the fallen leaves.
My antlers push low branches aside.
In the woods my steps are light.
Petals ride the wind in the cherry grove.
I stop at the grass and sniff.
Four legs, walking steady.
I hop over the low shrubs.

lines.zh: 我在听林子里面的声音
lines.en: I listen to the sounds inside the forest.
Grass still hangs from my antlers.

lines.en: Sunlight falls through the leaves onto my back.
The dew on the grass isn't dry yet.

Something moves in the distance.

lines.en: Ears up — I heard you snap a twig.
I'll graze here a little.

One hop and I'm somewhere else.
Don't come that close.

Both my ears are up.

I can run off on my own.
Closer and I'll bound away.

My antler got knocked crooked.

Don't come any closer.

I won't snatch; I'll wait a moment.

lines.zh: 这鹿饼干，我用鼻子拱走。
lines.en: I nudge this deer biscuit aside with my nose.
This lasts me a little while.
I look up at you.

lines.zh: 鞍子挂在我背上，有点痒。
lines.en: The saddle on my back itches a little.
You startled me.
All I can do is butt with my antlers.

lines.en: Chase me and I leap the whole fern patch.

Eight points; I can't trade blows.
I'll simply back off.
You step forward, I step back.
Don't corner me.

lines.zh: 鹿眼里，你的影子没动过。
lines.en: In the deer's eye, your shadow never moved.
My ears point your way.
I retreat step by step.
My hooves scrape the ground.
You take one step; I take two back.
I can bolt at any moment.
There are plenty of trees here.
One dart and I'm gone.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢这么近的距离
lines.en: I don't like this distance.
Closer and I run.
My forelegs lift.
I bump you and back off.
That one was light.
My antlers pushed you back.
I only want you to step away.
My antler grazed you.
Back off, these hooves aren't just decoration.

lines.zh: 鹿角往前一顶，够你记一阵。
lines.en: One shove of my antlers and you'll remember it.
One more deer in the woods.

lines.zh: 毛被燎了，我往林子里钻
lines.en: My coat singed; I bolted into the woods.
I fell and caught myself on one leg.

This force weakens my legs.
Not enough grass; hunger makes me tremble.
